Historical Reconstruction: Alphabet (GOOGL) 2026Q1 Preview
Data cutoff: 2026-02-04T23:59:59. Target event: 2026-04-29. This document is a retrospective reconstruction. It was not written before the target earnings release.

Preview
Baseline. Alphabet reported Q4 2025 on February 4, 2026. Consolidated revenue was $113.8 billion, up 18% year over year, or 17% in constant currency. Google Services revenue was $95.9 billion, up 14%. Google Cloud revenue was $17.7 billion, up 48%. Operating margin was about 32%. Diluted EPS was $2.82, up 31%. Full-year 2025 revenue exceeded $400 billion for the first time.

Company statements in the release. The company expected 2026 capital expenditures of $175–185 billion. Cloud run rate exceeded $70 billion. Gemini 3 launched. The Gemini app had more than 750 million monthly active users. Paid subscriptions exceeded 325 million. YouTube advertising plus subscriptions exceeded $60 billion for 2025.

Core questions for Q1 2026.
1. Will AI demand keep pushing Search and Cloud growth? Cloud grew 48% in Q4. Search grew 17%. Q1 calendar effects may affect Search differently from Q4.
2. Will costs limit margin? Q4 included a $2.1 billion Waymo employee compensation charge. Alphabet-level shared AI R&D costs were $5.9 billion. Q1 may face similar pressure.
3. How will the 2026 CapEx plan affect cash flow? The plan is $175–185 billion. In February 2026, Waymo announced a $16.0 billion investment round, mostly funded by Alphabet. In November 2025, Alphabet issued $24.8 billion of senior notes.

Positive variance. Cloud growth stays above 45%. Search growth stays above 15%. Operating margin stays near 32%.
Negative variance. Cloud growth drops below 35%. Search growth falls to high single digits. Alphabet-level costs rise. Operating margin falls below 30%.
Earnings checkpoints. Segment revenue and operating income. Cloud operating margin. TAC ratio. Other Bets loss. Cash flow. Capital expenditure commentary. Waymo-related charges.

Analysis
No contemporaneous preview existed in the supplied dataset. This reconstruction cannot be compared with a real prior preview. Actual Q1 2026 results were not available at the cutoff. The reconstruction uses only the Q4 2025 earnings release. Key facts were checked against that release. Q4 Cloud operating income was $5.3 billion, about 30% margin. Other Bets operating loss was $3.6 billion. The Waymo charge was $2.1 billion. These items explain profit pressure. Next-quarter focus: Search and Cloud growth, Cloud margin, TAC, Waymo costs, and CapEx cash outflows.
reader_questions: Cloud 增速 48% 是否主要来自低基数或一次性大单？新闻稿未给客户集中度或合同节奏，凭什么假设 Q1 能维持 40% 以上？
Q4 营业利润率 32% 是在包含 Waymo 2.1B 费用后取得；若 Q1 没有同等费用，利润率是否反而更容易改善？本稿将 Waymo 列为拖累是否可能高估风险？
2026 年 CapEx 指引 1750–1850 亿美元与 Waymo 融资叠加，到底会先体现在现金流/资产负债表，还是马上压利润？本稿没有自由现金流估算，读者如何判断承受能力？
fact_checks: 口径核对：除固定汇率营收增长外，全部财务数据为 GAAP；货币为美元，金额除 EPS 外为百万美元。
集团/分部核对：2025Q4 总营收 $113,828M，Google Services $95,862M，Google Cloud $17,664M，Other Bets $370M；对应 +18%、+14%、+48%、约 -8%。
利润核对：营业利润 $35,934M，营业利润率约 32%（文字稿为 31.6%）；Cloud 分部营业利润 $5,313M；Other Bets -$3,617M；Alphabet 层面 -$5,894M；EPS $2.82，同比 +31%；Waymo 员工薪酬费用 $2.1B。
公司声明核对：2026 年 CapEx 预计 $175–185B、Cloud 年末运行率超 $70B、Gemini 3 上线、Gemini App 月活超 750M、付费订阅超 325M、YouTube 广告加订阅全年收入超 $60B、2025 年 11 月发行高级无担保票据净融资 $24.8B、2026 年 2 月 Waymo 宣布 $16.0B 融资轮。
本稿推论 vs 事实：Cloud 增速能否维持、Search 日历效应、利润率变化、CapEx 现金流压力均为推论，不是公司指引或市场共识；未使用股价、盈利预测或任何财报后信息。
